name: a11y-nvda-screen-reader-pass
description: Completes each critical user journey with NVDA on Windows in Firefox and Chrome, using browse mode quick-navigation keys, focus mode, the Elements List and Speech Viewer transcripts, and records name, role, value, state, structure and announcement failures against SC 1.3.1, 2.4.4, 2.4.6, 4.1.2 and 4.1.3.
